description: Create a channel in NextGen Connect that transforms HL7 v2.x messages into XML format. The channel should be named 'HL7 Transformer Channel', accept HL7 messages via a TCP Listener, and include transformation logic that converts the incoming HL7 format to XML. The transformed output should be written to files. A sample HL7 ORU^R01 (Observation Result) message is available at /home/ga/sample_oru_message.hl7 for testing. You can use the terminal window to interact with the system. The REST API is available at https://localhost:8443/api (credentials: admin/admin). All REST API calls require the header 'X-Requested-With: OpenAPI'. The web dashboard at https://localhost:8443 is monitoring-only. Channel XML must include a <responseTransformer> element in destination connectors. Note: File Writer output files are created inside the Docker container filesystem, not the host VM.
